name: Chris Tham
headline: Strategy Consultant | Technology Strategy, Architecture and Business Change
summary: Founder of Hello Tham, a boutique strategy consulting company. Available for short to medium term consulting engagements spanning strategic business change, business and operating model design, business process improvement, and technology strategy, architecture and solutions.

achievements.title: Flexible strategic change agent and thought leader
achievements.detail: Led IT strategies and operating models: as a consultant to Transport for NSW and Transfield Services, and earlier in-house at ING, NAB and MLC. I continue that work today through Hello Tham, the consultancy I founded in 2016.

achievements.title: Successful and proven technology strategy and architecture leader
achievements.detail: Head of Architecture roles at NAB, ING and MLC, where my practice was profiled as a case study at international conferences. I am currently consulting to Cochlear as their Enterprise Architect.

achievements.title: Recognised technology innovator and industry expert
achievements.detail: Pioneered AI/ML dashboards, omni-channel self-service chatbots and the service-oriented architecture that earned NAB a software patent. These days I shape AI architecture for Cochlear, teach Information Systems at Torrens University and have written AI-dō, a book on working with AI.
